reviewer: GPT-6 Astra in a separate read-only implementation-review context
scope: Public exporter, verifier, oracle, privacy scanner, negative controls, and artifact binding.
initial_major_finding: Escaped JSON member names were not scanned after decoding, and duplicate members could discard an earlier value before privacy inspection.
fix: Scan decoded JSON member names as well as values.
Reject duplicate JSON members before constructing an object that could discard one.
Use strict decoding for manifest-refresh control documents before normalization.
Reject non-finite constants and non-UTF8 structured inputs.
Exercise nested keys, decoded-equivalent duplicates, registered addenda, refresh, and full validation.
preservation: Only authored gate/test/documentation files and their manifest bindings changed. Frozen programs, observations, and upstream reference bytes remain unchanged.
boundary: Automated implementation review, not human peer review, authenticated historical model provenance, or a general-purpose sandbox certification.
publication_timing: The gaps were corrected before the initial public release.
